issues.message: Not yet placed by a builder GameTest: stone_brick_wall, vine, iron_bars, red_wall_banner, moss_carpet, red_banner.
Only 179 blocks: too bare for a landmark (at least 200). Carlton wants more detail, not less.
The roof does not reach past the walls on any two opposite sides: give it one block of overhang.

notes.detail: Raised iron-bar portcullis on the town side, banner on the central merlon, vines, hay, barrel, lanterns on wall posts, moss on the walk.
notes.roof: Tower caps unchanged: flat spruce stair pairs, no overhang.
notes.grandeur: Nicely dressed but still a small gate; the towers do not dominate the wall.

visual.summary: L2 plus a raised portcullis, a banner on the central merlon, vines, hay, a barrel and moss on the walk; the most lived-in level.
problems: Tower caps (y8 spruce stair pairs) still look like flat boards; give them a proper top.
Towers should rise a few blocks higher to read as a landmark gate.
Portcullis bars (2..4,3..4,3) hang in open air with nothing above at (2..4,5,3); a lintel at y5 z3 between the towers would make it look supported.
Reachability: walk at y5 has no stair in this piece; reached from a neighbouring wall_tower - fine for a module.

issues.message: Not yet placed by a builder GameTest: stone_brick_wall, vine, red_wall_banner, iron_bars, moss_carpet, red_banner.
178 blocks, over the module budget of 60 (docs/STRUCTURES.md). A warning only.

notes.artefacts: Last round's floating portcullis fixed: bars (x2-4 y3-4 z3) now hang from a stone lintel at y5 z3.
notes.levels: Portcullis + lintel, standing banner on the middle merlon, supplies (hay, barrel) and ivy: clearly the fortified level.
notes.depth: Portcullis and lintel add depth at the back; tower sides still plain.

visual.summary: Level 3 fortifies the gate: an iron portcullis under a stone lintel on the town side, a standing banner over the arch, hay and a barrel by the towers and ivy.
problems: Joins OK (same as L1); walk y5 still clear over the arch (moss carpets only).
